# Codex project API schema fixtures

These four unmodified JSON Schemas were generated by the installed official `codex-cli 0.163.0-alpha.10.2` on 2026-10-20:

```sh
codex app-server generate-json-schema --experimental --out /tmp/codex-project-schema
```

`ProjectListParams.json` and `ProjectListResponse.json` came from `v2/`. `InitializeParams.json` and `InitializeResponse.json` came from `v1/`.

The client uses stdio JSON Lines, `initialize`, `initialized`, and the experimental `project/list` method. It does not create threads or start model turns. The tests validate fixtures and requests against these official version-specific schemas through the MCP SDK's JSON Schema validator.

The generated schema permits an omitted `nextCursor`. The reader additionally requires an explicit string or null cursor before reconciling a complete catalog, so a truncated or changed response cannot be mistaken for an empty final page. It also rejects relative roots, repeated project IDs, repeated cursors, oversized messages, and excessive page or project counts.

Sources: [App-server protocol and schema generation](https://developers.openai.com/codex/app-server), [official 0.163.0-alpha.10.2 release](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.163.0-alpha.10.2).
